scope: One retrospective study on an AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 (16 physical cores, 32 logical threads) with a Radeon 8060S integrated GPU. Measurements describe this invocation under shared local load.

fit.placement: OS scheduling within the existing process affinity. No loader, prefetch or nested process pools. Fixed float32 objective, optimizer, draws, order and batch size.

artifacts: Training data selection, model scales and weights were sealed before assessment scoring. All individual model timings are kept with private fit hashes. Parent-process GNU time peak RSS was 687364 KiB for fitting. The forkserver workers are omitted from that accounting, so the combined fitting peak RSS and combined CPU time are unknown. The sum of per-fit elapsed intervals includes concurrent work and excludes data reading, scaling and serialization.

route_checks.description: Original width-16 CPU1, CPU2 and GPU prefix timings, with matched outputs, were available before scientific fits. After scoring, a development-only resource check measured new widths 8 and 32 on the same 32-update prefix for the three-person first order. All routes produced the same 128 predictions within 3.6e-7 standardized output units. One fresh process per route imports packages, loads development-only data, trains and serializes the prefix output. Warm GPU memory, frequency and filesystem cache were uncontrolled under shared system use.
route_checks.gpu_initial_attempt: Failed with LLVM disk-quota error. The same bounded prefix succeeded using a private temporary and cache path.
route_checks.interpretation: All scientific fits used the original one-thread CPU route. A single two-thread prefix was 0.17 s faster for the new widths. A full four-process/two-thread sweep would need a matched throughput and memory comparison before claiming a production gain. GPU kernels and work-group sizes are controlled by PyTorch/ROCm. No GPU scientific fitting, energy, provider billing, closed-loop latency or frontier compute result is reported.

pressure: Before fitting, CPU PSI some avg10 was 0.52%, memory and I/O PSI some avg10 were 0.00%. Snapshots after scoring read 5.35%, 0.00% and 0.09%. GPU and CPU temperature snapshots after the measured work were 37.0 and 67.75 °C. These shared-system snapshots cannot isolate this job's pressure or peak temperature.
